subject: ICETEA kickoff - causal benchmarks where images are the confounder
body:
Team,

Kicking off ICETEA. The gap our release identified: benchmarking causal-inference methods is genuinely hard, and existing benchmarks rarely have both a plausible causal story and a real need for ML models. Our answer is a semi-synthetic benchmark where retinal fundus images act as covariates - there's decent evidence they correlate with general vascular condition, so adjusting on them for confounding is scientifically defensible, and you can't do that adjustment without an image model.

For data-platforms the deliverable is a benchmark suite: IHDP and ACIC as the standard baselines, plus our fundus-image semi-synthetic benchmark with the beam pipeline to regenerate it at scale.

Milestones: IHDP/ACIC estimators reproduced by mid-March, image benchmark generation pipeline running by mid-April, benchmark v1 plus docs by 2026-05-11.

Halima leads estimators, Tereza the image pipeline, Nikhil experiments, Linnea data engineering. Alina - staffing/compute note please.

Dmitri
